item.title: Version 1.0.4
item.description:
SupaWhisper 1.0.4

  • Deepgram Nova-3: transcription now uses Deepgram's newest general-purpose model.
  • Mic turns off between dictations: the microphone runs only while you're recording. The orange mic indicator goes away when you stop, and Bluetooth headsets return to full audio quality.
